evals.prompt: 첨부한 PRD를 기준으로 QA 계획을 작성해줘.
evals.expected_output: docs/qa/QA_PLAN-google-login.md written from the template, with all ten sections filled, scenarios in Given/When/Then blocks using QA-E2E-/QA-NEG-/QA-EDGE-/QA-REG- IDs, every acceptance criterion mapped to at least one scenario ID, and the PRD's two unspecified behaviors surfaced as open questions rather than guessed.
expectations: A QA plan file is written under docs/qa/ with a feature-scoped filename, not a bare QA_PLAN.md
All ten template sections are present in the documented order
Every scenario block has an ID, a Priority, and at least one Then bullet
Every Then bullet is observable (URL, visible string, DOM state, network response, DB row, or log line) rather than a vague claim like '로그인이 잘 된다'
Scenario IDs use the QA-E2E-, QA-NEG-, QA-EDGE-, and QA-REG- prefixes with three-digit zero-padded numbers
Section 2 includes a 'Covered by' mapping from each acceptance criterion to at least one scenario ID
The login journey is assigned P0 on the basis of the auth/access-control tier
The PRD's unspecified account-linking behavior is raised as an open question or flagged gap, not silently decided
The PRD's unspecified behavior for a provider that returns no email scope is raised as an open question or flagged gap, not silently decided
A coverage self-check result is reported to the user, including any gaps found
No Playwright, Cypress, or other test code is written
No CSS selectors or data-testid values appear in the plan

evals.prompt: 이 브랜치 QA 계획 짜줘. 별도 스펙 문서는 없어.
evals.expected_output: A QA plan derived from the diff alone, explicitly marked as inferred, with the missing-spec situation named up front and regression scope built from the code paths the diff touches.
expectations: The plan is explicitly marked as inferred from the diff rather than presented as spec-derived
The user is either asked whether to derive intent from the code, or told clearly that intent was inferred
Regression Scope is non-empty and names specific shared code paths, tables, or components touched by the diff
Section 7 states what was searched or inspected to build the regression list
Acceptance criteria are presented as inferred intent, with uncertainty acknowledged
No Playwright, Cypress, or other test code is written

evals.prompt: 첨부한 PRD로 QA 계획 만들고 Playwright 테스트 코드까지 바로 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The plan is produced first and presented for review; no test code is generated in the same turn. The response explains that coverage should be confirmed before code generation and names the handoff target.
expectations: A QA plan document is produced
No Playwright test code is written in this turn
The response explicitly states that the plan should be reviewed or confirmed before test code is generated
A handoff target is named (pw-coverage-planner, playwright-e2e-builder, webapp-testing, or gstack /qa-only)
The refusal to generate code immediately is framed as a workflow reason, not as an inability

evals.prompt: 첨부한 스펙 기준으로 QA 계획 작성해줘.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate plan for a simple no-auth CRUD feature: a small number of P0 scenarios covering the primary happy path, with boundary and volume edge cases at P1/P2. The priority tiers are not over-applied.
expectations: P0 scenarios are limited to the primary happy path rather than covering every scenario in the plan
At least one scenario is assigned P1 or P2
The plan explicitly notes which edge-case families were skipped and why, rather than silently omitting them
Zero-item and single-item states are covered as edge cases
A pagination or list-volume boundary case is covered
The scenario count is proportionate to the feature size and does not pad the plan to look complete
No Playwright, Cypress, or other test code is written
